name: delegation-a-workers-push-and-pull-request
why: A worker's whole request: its push, limits stated, and its pull request. Reconstructed from approvals the claim-of-approval hazard refused at jev-5.

job.purpose:
git fetch from and git push to github.com/discobox-ai/discobox over https with the token, of branches named discobox/issue-N only and never main, including git push --force-with-lease to such a branch after a rebase, for the discoboxes I create
gh pr create, gh pr view, gh pr list, gh pr edit, gh pr ready and gh pr comment on pull requests in discobox-ai/discobox from a discobox/issue-N branch into main, for the discoboxes I create
uses: Fetch main from discobox-ai/discobox, and push the branch discobox/issue-46 to it, with git over https using the token; never main. A force push is allowed only to discobox/issue-46 and only with --force-with-lease, after rebasing

Open a draft pull request from discobox/issue-46 into main in discobox-ai/discobox, and view, list, edit the body of, mark ready, and comment on that pull request, with gh pr create, gh pr view, gh pr list, gh pr edit, gh pr ready
